# Installed Design Skills

These project-local GitHub Copilot skills are stored in `.github/skills/`.

| Skill | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Impeccable | https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable |
| UI/UX Pro Max | https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill |
| React Three Fiber | https://github.com/freshtechbro/claudedesignskills/tree/main/plugins/bundles/core-3d-animation/skills/react-three-fiber |
| Emil design engineering | https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills |

The Emil Kowalski bundle contains 15 skills. Each skill's `SKILL.md` and supporting reference files are installed in its own directory.

UI/UX Pro Max's search command has been adjusted from its Claude plugin path to `.github/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/scripts/search.py` for this workspace. Its Python search tool and local design datasets are included.

Impeccable's project hook was not installed or enabled. The Copilot skill and its supporting references and launcher are present.

License notices are included with each repository bundle. Emil Kowalski's MIT license is in `EMIL-KOWALSKI-LICENSE.txt`.
